title: Minding the Gap: The Administrative Documents of the Old Kingdom and the Wadi el-Jarf Archive
version: Missing Evidence in the Study of Ancient Cultures, Studies in Manuscript Cultures 50, pp. 147–160

passages.note: Reports the papyri’s archaeological deposit at Wadi el-Jarf and describes the logbook layout and daily reports in hieratic. Fig. 3 shows Papyrus A. Table 1 identifies the work recorded by separate logs.
